title: "The Silent Christian is a Disobedient Christian – Speak Up!" 🔥
paragraphs:
"The Silent Christian is a Disobedient Christian – Speak Up!" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Why are so many Christians silent?

We speak up about politics.
We share memes, news, and trends.
We promote brands, sports, and entertainment.
But when it comes to Jesus… silence.
📖 “Whoever acknowledges Me before others, I will also acknowledge before My Father in heaven. But whoever disowns Me before others, I will disown before My Father in heaven.” (Matthew 10:32-33)
💡 Being a silent Christian is being a disobedient Christian.

🔥 Why Staying Silent About Jesus is Dangerous
1️⃣ Your Silence May Lead Others to Hell
Imagine this:
Your friend, family member, or coworker dies without Christ.

🚨 They never heard the Gospel from you.
🚨 You had the truth but kept it to yourself.
🚨 What if you were their last chance to hear about Jesus?
📖 “How can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard?” (Romans 10:14)
👉 If you don’t speak up, how will they know?

2️⃣ Silence is a Form of Denying Christ
Jesus was clear—if we are ashamed of Him, He will be ashamed of us.
📖 “Whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny before My Father in heaven.” (Matthew 10:33)

If you’re silent because of fear, embarrassment, or worrying about offending people, ask yourself:
Do I care more about people’s opinions than I care about Jesus?
🚨 Silence is choosing fear over faith.

3️⃣ Silence Lets Darkness Win
The world is filled with:
❌ False religions.
❌ Deception and lies.
❌ People teaching everything except the truth.
If Christians stay silent, who will speak the truth?
📖 “You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden.” (Matthew 5:14)
👉 God didn’t save you just to keep your faith private.

🔥 Why Are Christians Silent?
Many believers stay silent because of fear.
📖 “For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-discipline.” (2 Timothy 1:7)

Common Excuses Christians Make:
❌ "I don’t know enough about the Bible."

You don’t need a theology degree—just share what Jesus did in your life.
❌ "I don’t want to offend anyone."

The Gospel is offensive to sin, but it’s also the only way to salvation.
❌ "I’m not a preacher."

Evangelism is not just for pastors—it’s for EVERY believer.
💡 Fear is not from God—boldness is.

🔥 How to Break Your Silence and Speak Up for Jesus
1️⃣ Start with Your Testimony

Share how Jesus changed your life—nobody can argue with your personal experience.
📖 “We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom.” (Colossians 1:28)
2️⃣ Use Social Media for Christ

If you can post about movies, food, and opinions, you can post about Jesus!
📖 “Go into all the world and preach the Gospel to all creation.” (Mark 16:15)
3️⃣ Pray for Boldness

The early church prayed for boldness—and they changed the world.
📖 “They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.” (Acts 4:31)
4️⃣ Tell At Least One Person About Jesus Today

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 17, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose to break my silence. I will boldly share my faith and point others to Jesus Christ. I will not let fear stop me from obeying God’s call to be a witness for Him."

🔥 THE “SPEAK UP” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Share your testimony with one person today.
✅ Step 2: Post a Bible verse or Gospel message on social media.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and encourage them to share their faith boldly.

🌌 YOU ARE CALLED TO BE BOLD FOR JESUS 🌌
📖 “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.” (Matthew 9:37)
👉 Don’t let fear hold you back. Your boldness could change someone’s eternity.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 17, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Forgive me for the times I’ve stayed silent when I should have spoken up about You. Give me boldness to share my faith, to proclaim Jesus in every area of my life, and to stand firm in a world that rejects the truth. Fill me with Your Holy Spirit and use me to bring others into Your Kingdom.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
